limitations: Partial individual career evidence, not complete season squads.
Only interior calendar years of a closed senior interval are used; all transfer boundary years and potentially overlapping loans/reserve/unknown clubs are excluded.
No dates are invented from year-only membership. Nationality and broad position reuse previously validated roster metadata, not historical sporting nationality or ratings.
Wikidata P54 quarantine is unchanged; name and birthday alone never create a cross-provider identifier.
All explicit loan spells are excluded: year-only playing-club evidence does not establish the lending club or loan contract.
